h1: Wangtaparb Resort Prachinburi — a riverside rafting base by Kaeng Hin Phoeng, where you wake to the river and forest
intro: If your plan is to raft Kaeng Hin Phoeng or kayak in Na Di and you want to sleep right by the water so you wake up to the river and the forest — Wangtaparb Resort is a name Prachinburi rafters keep mentioning. It's a 3-star riverside resort in Saphan Hin subdistrict, Na Di District, with around 50 riverside-house rooms with private balconies. It's a family-run resort that doubles as a base for rafting and kayaking, with its own restaurant and convenience store. Rates start at about ฿1,200/night, rising into the high thousands for bigger rooms or during the high-water rainy season.

body.html: The heart of Wangtaparb Resort is its riverside location, used directly as a base for rafting Kaeng Hin Phoeng. Kaeng Hin Phoeng is a grade 3-5 rafting run of about 4.5 km, at its most beautiful and powerful in the rainy season, roughly July to October. The resort arranges boats, kayaks and a guiding team all in one place, so groups of friends or company trips don't have to chase an outside operator - you can simply book the room and the activity together.

Rooms are riverside houses with private balconies. There's a range to choose from, from Baan Rim Naam (the riverside house) to Baan Mali. Inside you get air-con, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and an en-suite bathroom. What real reviews agree on is that rooms are clean, beds are comfy, and sitting on the balcony watching the river in the morning is a feeling you simply can't get from an in-town tower hotel in Prachinburi.
"A family-run riverside resort with kayaking and rafting to do, clean rooms, cold air-con, big comfy beds and good food - it feels like visiting relatives who live right by the water."

Food is sorted too. There's an on-site restaurant and a small convenience store on the grounds. Breakfast is served roughly 7-10 am; most rates require a package that includes breakfast, or you pay extra if you book a room without it. That matters with a setting like this, because the resort sits in a natural area with no restaurants within easy walking distance - having a kitchen on site helps a lot.

The grounds are spacious, with free parking and enough open space for group trips or functions. Plenty of people use the place for riverside weddings or seminars, since there's an activity lawn and meeting rooms. The overall feel is quiet, leafy and nature-focused - this isn't a luxury resort with a spa or an infinity pool. Most people who come here are here to play in the water, raft, and relax in nature rather than to chase luxury.

To be honest about the location: the resort is in Na Di District, a fair way from the centre of Prachinburi, and the final stretch is a road into a natural area. It suits self-drivers best - without a car, getting here is awkward. And because it's a riverside resort in the middle of nature, the high-water rainy season is the rafting highlight, but you should always check the weather and safety conditions with the resort first.

Overall, Wangtaparb Resort earns high real-review scores on both Trip.com and Tripadvisor, especially for cleanliness, its riverside location, and the friendly family-resort feel. Rates start around ฿1,200 for a standard double, rising with the room type and water season into the high thousands for bigger rooms or activity packages. If you're here to raft Kaeng Hin Phoeng, kayak, or sleep by the water in nature on a few-thousand-baht budget, this place hits the mark.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you're coming to raft, aim for July to October when the water is strongest and most beautiful, and book the room with an activity package in advance, since rooms fill fast during high water. If you want the full on-the-water feel, ask for a riverside house with the balcony facing straight out over the river.

honestSummary: Wangtaparb Resort is a solid pick for anyone here to raft Kaeng Hin Phoeng or sleep by the water in nature on a few-thousand-baht budget - a family-run riverside resort that arranges rafting and kayaking on site, with clean riverside-house rooms, a restaurant and a convenience store. The trade-off is the Na Di location that needs a car, and that it's not a luxury resort with a spa or pool.
honestChecks: If you don't have your own car - the resort is in Na Di, far from town, and the final stretch is a road into a natural area -> for staying in central Prachinburi, look at IRabbit Hotel or Jiphome instead.
If you're mainly here to raft - the water is strongest and most beautiful from July to October, and low outside the season -> check the timing and book an activity package with the resort in advance.

If you want a luxury resort with a spa and pool - this place leans into nature and water activities rather than luxury -> for an upscale hillside resort, consider Siamdasada or myrrh. Resort in the Noen Hom area.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Wangtaparb Resort Prachinburi

faq.q: Where is Wangtaparb Resort in Prachinburi, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Wangtaparb Resort is at 40 Moo 4, Saphan Hin, Na Di District, Prachinburi. It's a riverside resort right on the Kaeng Hin Phoeng rafting run, on the Prachinburi edge of Khao Yai National Park. It's about an hour's drive from central Prachinburi, so it suits self-drivers.

faq.q: How much does Wangtaparb Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿1,200/night for a riverside double. Choices run from Baan Rim Naam (the riverside house) to Baan Mali and family rooms. Prices rise with the room type and the water season into the high thousands - always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Wangtaparb Resort offer rafting, and when is the best time?
faq.a: Yes. The resort is a base for rafting Kaeng Hin Phoeng, arranging boats, kayaks and a guiding team on site. Kaeng Hin Phoeng is a grade 3-5 run of about 4.5 km, strongest and most beautiful from July to October. You can book the room with an activity package in advance.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Wangtaparb Resort?
faq.a: Rooms are riverside houses with private balconies, air-con, flat-screen TVs, fridges and en-suite bathrooms. Real reviews praise clean rooms, cold air-con, big comfy beds, and sitting on the balcony to watch the river in the morning - a family-style riverside resort feel.

faq.q: Who is Wangtaparb Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for anyone here to raft Kaeng Hin Phoeng, kayak, or sleep by the water in nature on a few-thousand-baht budget - groups of friends, company trips and families alike. Because it's in Na Di on a road into a natural area, it suits self-drivers more than those without a car.

faq.q: Does Wangtaparb Resort have a restaurant and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's an on-site restaurant, a convenience store, and free parking on spacious grounds. Breakfast is served roughly 7-10 am; most rates need a package that includes breakfast or an extra charge, since the surroundings are a natural area with no restaurants close by.
